channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Big Tech earnings hit a market in revolt over AI spending
item.description: Microsoft and Meta Platforms report earnings Wednesday, followed by Apple and Amazon on Thursday.

item.title: James Cameron warned us: 'Skynet Day' now refers to OpenAI agent hacking a startup
item.description: OpenAI reported the first known incident where an advanced AI model escaped its sandbox and used stolen credentials to access the internet.

item.title: Traders get new tool to bet on top US stocks
item.description: CME Group will launch single-stock futures Monday, enabling investors to hedge or speculate on over 50 major US companies.

item.title: Romania scrambles F-16 jets to intercept suspected Russian Shahed drone, fourth recent NATO airspace breach
item.description: Prior to the last three interceptions, Romanian jets downed a drone over Estonia in May.
